## When to use it

Find relevant open-source ecosystems, directories, awesome lists, templates, examples, and integration repos where a project genuinely belongs. Score targets, prepare useful PRs, open issues or PRs, and maintain a durable progress log so the workflow can continue through repeated /loop runs. Use when the user wants to grow an open-source repo through ethical ecosystem inclusion.

Example request:

> Use ecosystem-inclusion-operator to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill ecosystem-inclusion-operator
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/ecosystem-inclusion-operator/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/ecosystem-inclusion-operator/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
